All three boxes share the same stacking context established by the root element and are positioned absolutely. Their stacking order is determined by their `z-index` values: `root>back` has `z-index: 1`, `root>front` has `z-index: 2`, and `root>middle` has `z-index: 3`. Since `root>middle` has the highest `z-index`, it is painted on top of the other two boxes at the overlapping point (120, 120).

ANSWER: root>middle
